issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

guideTokenizerPath.description:
Path to zip containing tokenizer used in {@link Genai.Llm.Guide}.
Must be set to do query orchestration in an airgapped environment.

attributorTokenizerPath.description: The path to the tokenizer files used for the attributor.

fewShotEmbedderModelName.description: Name of the to e5 embedder model `intfloat/multilingual-e5-small` used in {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.FewShotRetriever}

fewShotEmbedderPath.description:
Path to embedder model used in {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.FewShotRetriever}. The top-level contents of this
folder should include files/folders called config.json, modules.json, 1_Pooling/..., etc.

pgVectorEmbedderPath.description:
Path to the embedder model used in {@link Genai.Retriever.PgVector}. The top-level contents of this folder
should include files/folders called config.json, modules.json, 1_Pooling/..., etc.

nltkSentenceTokenizerModelFilePath.description:
Corresponds to nltk_sentence_tokenizer_model_file_path - the file path to NLTK punkt model (e.g. english.pickle file)
Used in attribution (on unstructured query).

nltkResourcesFilePath.description:
Corresponds to the resources used in nltk for collocations, abbreviations, etc.
https://huggingface.co/spaces/drewThomasson/ebook2audiobook/tree/de460b84ccb9ff8468121263a6f4bb7d6b7b6bc8/nltk_data/tokenizers/punkt_tab/english

nltkTaggersFilePath.description: Corresponds to averaged_perceptron_tagger - used in pos tagging

msmarcoDistilbertBaseTasBFilePath.description:
The file path to the TASB model and tokenizer for the Rationale Embedder.
Used in attribution (on unstructured query).

sourceFileChunkerTokenizerPath.description:
Tokenizer used in {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker} when determining token length.
Used in file chunking (unstructured data).

tableTextSplitterEncoderPath.description:
Tokenizer used in the TableTextSplitter used in chunking.
Used in file chunking (unstructured data).

tokenTextSplitterEncoderPath.description:
Tokenizer used in `TokenTextSplitter`
Should contain the zip to encoder.json and vocab.bpe
For gpt2 it can be downloaded from:
vocab_bpe_file="https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/gpt-2/encodings/main/vocab.bpe",
encoder_json_file="https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/gpt-2/encodings/main/encoder.json",
The files in the zip should be renamed to the hash which can be obtained by running `hashlib.sha1(<url>.encode()).hexdigest()`

tatrZipPath.description:
Path to zip containing Table Transformer (TATR) model.
Used in file chunking (unstructured data), when using the TablePdf chunker ({@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.TablePdf}).
While downloading the pretrained model make sure to include `revision="no-timm"` and use the updated zip
Post on "Unable to load model offline" https://huggingface.co/microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition/discussions

nougatZipPath.description:
Path to zip containing Nougat model.
Used in file chunking (unstructured data), when using the TablePdf chunker ({@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.TablePdf}) and {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.MultimodalPdf}.

detectronZipPath.description:
Path to zip containing the Detectron2LayoutModel's model_final.pth and config.yml.
Used in file chunking (unstructured data), when using {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.MultimodalPdf} without the layout parsing.

dprQuestionEncoderPath.description: Path to zip containing question encoder used in {@link Genai.Retriever.Dense.Embedder#DPR}.

dprContextEncoderPath.description: Path to zip containing context encoder used in {@link Genai.Retriever.Dense.Embedder#DPR}.

misTokenizerPath.description: Path to zip containing tokenizer used in MIS.

title:
Configs for C3 Generative AI deployments in airgapped environments.
For each of these configs, if not set, the system will try to download the associated tokenizer/model from the internet.
name: Genai.App.AirGapConfig
